Avid fan of the ''Wheel of Time'' series since at least the early 90's; I read [[The Eye of the World]] in high school, then forgot about it for a time, until my mother bought me Books 1, 2, 3 & 4 for Christmas - and then it was off to the races.

Mainly functioning as technical backup and sounding board here, but you can ask anything as long as you don't mind getting an "''I have '''no''' idea''" from time to time... 

==Current status==
WAY too busy to be here reliably, but I try to get on once or twice a <s>week</s> year or so. I've finished all of the main sequence books, so spoilers are fine on my talk page, etc. Looking forward to the Origins book!
